title: The Selfish Squirrel Who Hid All The Acorns: True Friendship!

lines.text: Sammy the squirrel collected five hundred crunchy acorns in his secret hollow oak!
lines.caps: Sammy the squirrel *COLLECTED | five hundred acorns in his *SECRET | hollow *OAK!

lines.text: Mine, all mine! Sammy cheered, sitting on his giant mountain of nuts!
lines.caps: *MINE, all mine! Sammy *CHEERED, | sitting on his giant *MOUNTAIN | of *NUTS!

lines.text: Outside his tree, the winter wind whistled cold, and tiny birds searched for food!
lines.caps: Outside his *TREE, | the winter wind whistled *COLD, | and tiny birds *SEARCHED!

lines.text: Sammy ate ten acorns alone in the dark, but his heart felt cold and hollow!
lines.caps: Sammy ate ten acorns *ALONE, | but his heart felt cold and *HOLLOW!

lines.text: Having all the treasure in the forest is boring when you have zero friends to play with!
lines.caps: Having all the treasure is *BORING | when you have *ZERO | friends to play *WITH!

lines.text: Sammy pushed his door open and shouted, Acorn picnic at my tree, everyone!
lines.caps: Sammy pushed his door *OPEN | and shouted, *ACORN PICNIC | at my tree, *EVERYONE!

lines.text: Rabbits, bluebirds, and mice gathered round, singing cheerful songs together!
lines.caps: Rabbits, bluebirds, and *MICE | gathered round, singing *CHEERFUL | songs *TOGETHER!

lines.text: Joy multiplies when you share it with open paws and a warm heart!
lines.caps: Joy multiplies when you *SHARE IT | with open paws and a *WARM | *HEART!

lines.text: Open your heart and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily stories!
lines.caps: Open your *HEART | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *STORIES!
